mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published_count, COUNT(*) AS article_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_category) AS category_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tag) AS tag_count FROM tb_article

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.view_count FROM tb_article a LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_article_tag fat WHERE fat.article_id = a.id AND fat.tag_id = #{tagId} )
ORDER BY a.view_count DESC, a.id ASC
